headline: Nigerian Pension Regulator Seeks Reforms as Private Workers Face Poverty
summary: Nigeria's National Pension Commission is seeking pension reforms targeting 3 million new accounts and has set a June 2027 recapitalization deadline for operators, amid concerns over inadequate retirement savings for private sector workers.
why: Regulatory reforms and recapitalization mandates in the pensions sector influence long-term institutional capital accumulation and domestic capital market depth.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Pension reforms alter domestic savings management and institutional investment patterns.
